lines: The countless masses, the people they become
Empty bravado, mental images, like a monster beyond humanity
With an open heart, life takes residence
And then a hollow, meaningless human
Expectations gather, an unequal life
No talent, grand illusion, the extraordinary
All parents equal, individuality erased
The memories I trace
Because there is no place to belong
Don’t just cry in the gap of a dream
I know exactly what face I should wear
But still, answer me
Purify the darkness, purify the darkness
When night’s veil falls, that’s the signal
Confront each other, the circling ring battle
Spit out the nonsense
Don’t stop yet, don’t stop yet
More perceptive than anyone, this true self born in the city
Now I only create the cursed future that haunts me
Run, fall, clutch the unending pain
The world awaits this fleeting moment
Lyric, emotions wobble like a glitch
The penalty of a flaw that obeyed obediently
Only a death‑defending choice, love’s impermanence
Unable to raise my voice, as it is
A puppet’s oath‑less hundred‑ghost procession
Linked like beads, even to the very end
Kick away reality, calm, don’t throw my life away
Soak in my inner fragility
I don’t know what face to wear
Now just answer me
Untie the five constants, untie the five constants
Weave an uncertain voice, an idea
Cancel out, the emotions that spin
Beyond that, now, a hand that rises
Just chase it, just chase it
Wishing to be stronger than anyone, even your destiny
Now, at the bottom of this dim night
Falling deeper and deeper
Did it look clumsy
This is who I am now
Just a corpse that can become nothing—laugh at it
I’ve even stopped fleeing from everything before me
Repeating the image
Go beyond imagination
Purify the darkness, purify the darkness
When night’s veil falls, that’s the signal
Confront each other, the circling ring battle
Spit out the nonsense
Don’t stop yet, don’t stop yet
More perceptive than anyone, this true self born in the city
Now I only create the cursed future that haunts me
Run, fall, clutch the unending pain
The world awaits this fleeting moment
